plan.objective: Ship Exo 0.3.0 with a clean-break normalized relational execution core, safe agent runtime coordination, and post-cutover parallel research scale-out.
acceptanceCriteria: WS0 host pass starts as a real main module, touches host state on startup, releases expired task leases, and no longer crashes on HOST_STATE_LOCK_* temporal dead zone.
WS1 reduces exo next --json latency by at least 60 percent against the current dataset while keeping output JSON shape unchanged.
WS2 makes run-agent-host-pass.js the only lane-lock owner, shrinks the shell runner lock to a spawn guard, and writes fresh merged agent-last-pass.json from scheduled-style lane runs.
WS3 replaces motion payload execution state with normalized companies, people, employments, motion_accounts, prospects, prospect_drafts, signal_matches, and permanent activity_events tables.
WS3 keeps listMotions/findMotionById returning hydrated legacy-compatible motion views while deleting repair-on-read persistence for execution state.

WS3 relational write paths record touches, drafts, cadence, action results, claims, inbound transitions, config import, and motion removal transactionally with optimistic motion-core versioning where applicable.
WS3 person identity resolver passes LinkedIn member-id/public-id, URL-mining, alias, conflict-review, v10 normalization, employment, email-policy, and cross-motion ownership tests.
WS3 tracer gate proves a due send and concurrent sibling research draft both persist without clobbering.
WS3 cutover runbook preserves playbooks/config, wipes disposable execution state only after the approved gate, reimports config, reinstalls the routine, and verifies doctor/queue.
WS4 runs multiple research workers with disjoint task sets, keeps transport serial per identity, and surfaces per-lane status in doctor.
Full npm run check and npm test are green at every completed task commit and at final close-out.
No code path writes targetMap into motions.payload_json after WS3; config import strips legacy execution state.
constraints: Local-only: no Supabase, no sync hub, no cloud backend, no async storage interface.
Clean break for WS3: no staged hybrid store, no blob-explosion migration, no dual-write period.
Do not delete or wipe .exo/exo.db* until the explicit WS3 cutover task; user has approved the wipe gate, but the task still records the gate and backup steps before deletion.
Use node:sqlite synchronously and enable PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON.
Reads return legacy-compatible hydrated motion views until hot paths are converted.
Events are permanent and must not cascade-delete with motions or assignments.
One active outbound owner per person across motions; selection and send gates both enforce it.
Approval means sendable; draft approval/authorship stays queryable in columns.
Queue items stay atomic; batching belongs inside execution internals.
Work happens in the ignored worktree .worktrees/normalized-core-and-parallel-execution-plan on branch plan/normalized-core-and-parallel-execution-plan.
The worktree uses an ignored local .exo copy seeded from the original workspace for baseline tests; live shared-state reads still pin /Users/williamflanagan/Projects/omalab/exo/.exo when required.
nonGoals: Supabase, cloud hub, sync engine, event-log replication.
Broad command-handler thinning beyond write-path moves forced by normalization.
Cross-motion person merge UI/tooling unless duplicates actually accumulate.
Email, phone, and social enricher executors/provider waterfalls beyond schema, resolver registry, provenance, and task-lane hooks.

tasks.title: Fix host-pass main-module startup lock touch
tasks.context: WS0. Fix the P0 worker crash. Hoist HOST_STATE_LOCK_* constants into the top-of-file constant block and move the isMainModule entry block to end-of-file. Add startup host-state hygiene that releases expired task leases and prunes expired backoffs through mutateHostState on every pass, including noop passes. Regression must spawn the script as a real main module with EXO_STATE_DIR and cwd in a temp workspace whose agent-host-state.json contains an expired task lease. Cover no lane and EXO_AGENT_LANE=transport. The test must fail on current main because seeded mutation reaches the TDZ path.
doneWhen: Main-module spawned host pass exits 0 for no lane and transport lane with seeded expired task lease.
Expired lease is released and a pass summary is written.
Empty-workspace smoke still exits 0.
npm run check and npm test are green.
outputs: Added spawned main-module host-pass coverage for empty workspaces and expired host-state cleanup across default and transport lane passes.
Hoisted host-state lock constants, moved the main-module entrypoint to EOF, and persisted startup pruning through mutateHostState.
tasks.notes: Red: node --test test/agent-host-pass.test.js failed because expired taskLeases remained persisted. Green: node --test test/agent-host-pass.test.js passed. Gate: npm run check and npm test passed with 667 tests.

tasks.title: Make exo next reuse lazy description
tasks.context: WS1. buildNextView accepts an optional prebuilt description and computes it lazily only on fallback paths. next.js passes the description it already built. describeExo takes a lazy/lightweight recommendedPath path so fallback does not rebuild a full daily view it was handed. Preserve output JSON shape. Measure exo next --json before and after against the current dataset or a representative fixture; target at least 60 percent latency reduction, interim target around 700ms.
doneWhen: Output JSON for exo next --json is unchanged in snapshot/contract coverage.
Latency measurement shows at least 60 percent reduction against the current dataset or documented fixture.
npm run check and npm test are green.
outputs: buildNextView now reuses a provided description and computes describeExo lazily only for fallback paths.
exo next passes its prebuilt description into buildNextView.
Motion fallback uses a lightweight targeting pass for non-targeting-ready motions and preserves the exact live JSON output.
Live EXO_STATE_DIR baseline best 1017ms; after best 232ms; 77 percent reduction; output byte-for-byte unchanged against /tmp/exo-next-before-t02.json.
tasks.notes: Red: node --test test/build-next-view.test.js failed because fallback ignored the provided description; node --test test/evaluate-motion-targeting.test.js failed because unrelated companies were parsed before filtering. Green: focused tests passed. Gate: npm run check and npm test passed with 669 tests.

tasks.title: Move lane-lock ownership into host pass
tasks.context: WS2 part 1-2. run-agent-host-pass.js acquires tryAcquireAgentRunLock({ stateDir, lane }) at startup and exits with a noop summary when held. Remove duplicate CLI acquisition from runWorkerLanePass in src/cli/commands/agent.js; it interprets the child noop summary. Lock path/format stays unchanged for doctor. Shell runner lock becomes a spawn guard released after spawning lanes, not held through wait.
doneWhen: Two concurrent invocations of the same lane make the second exit noop with holder detail.
Transport lane can start while research lane lock is held.
Doctor still reports lock holders using the same lock path/format.
npm run check and npm test are green.
outputs: run-agent-host-pass.js now owns its lane-scoped run lock and persists a noop lane summary with holder pid detail when the lane is already active.
agent run no longer pre-acquires per-lane locks; child summaries are merged and sibling lanes keep running independently.
The shared agent run lock is now released after lane workers are spawned, making it a spawn guard instead of a wait-duration lock.
tasks.notes: Red: node --test test/agent-run.test.js test/agent-host-pass.test.js failed on host-pass lane-lock ownership, CLI duplicate lane pre-lock, and spawn guard release. Green: targeted tests passed. Gate: npm run check and npm test passed with 672 tests.

Each lane pass, at exit, regenerates agent-last-pass.json from lane files under the host-state lock. Scheduled-style lane run must leave a fresh merged agent-last-pass.json. Update routine artifact version/reinstall instructions in runbook/docs if artifacts encode version.
doneWhen: Scheduled-style lane run writes fresh merged agent-last-pass.json.
CLI and host pass use the shared merge implementation.
Routine artifact version and reinstall instruction are updated if required.
npm run check and npm test are green.
outputs: Moved mergeLanePassSummaries into src/lib/agent-pass-summary.js and routed both agent run and run-agent-host-pass.js through the shared writer.
Lane host-pass exits now write agent-last-pass.<lane>.json and rebuild the legacy agent-last-pass.json from all lane summaries under the shared host-state lock.
Extracted the host-state file lock to src/lib/agent-host-state-lock.js for reuse by host-state mutation and summary refresh.
Bumped routine artifact version to 2026-06-10-1 and updated generated launchd/cron runners so their shell lock releases immediately after spawning lane workers.
tasks.notes: Red: node --test test/agent-host-pass.test.js failed because scheduled-style lane runs left stale agent-last-pass.json in place. Green: node --test test/agent-run.test.js test/agent-host-pass.test.js test/agent-routine.test.js passed. Gate: npm run check and npm test passed with 673 tests.

tasks.title: Add consolidated normalized schema baseline
tasks.context: WS3 step 1. Rewrite migrations.js as consolidated version 1 full schema from the plan: final-form companies, motions core with version, motion_accounts, signal_matches, people, contact_points, employments, prospects, activity_events, prospect_drafts, plus nullable person_id on inbound_observations if kept. Add pre-0.3.0 ledger guard that exits with reinitialize required instead of repair. Enable PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON. Update existing insertMotion/updateMotion/insertCompany/updateCompany in the same commit so new NOT NULL columns are written. New tables can be additive with no writers yet.
doneWhen: Fresh DB creates all normalized baseline tables and indexes.
Pre-0.3.0 ledger guard fails closed with reinitialize required.
Existing motion/company writers work against the new columns.
Foreign key enforcement is enabled.
npm run check and npm test are green.
outputs: Replaced historical migrations with a consolidated normalized schema baseline at user_version 1, including motion_accounts, signal_matches, people, contact_points, employments, prospects, activity_events, and prospect_drafts.
Added fail-closed ReinitializeRequiredError handling for pre-0.3.0 ledgers and enabled SQLite foreign key enforcement during migration setup.
Updated motion, company, and inbound observation persistence for new normalized columns including motion.name, schema_version, company URLs, and nullable personId.
Added database schema coverage and updated CLI/inbound reconciliation tests for clean baseline behavior and isolated EXO_STATE_DIR usage.
tasks.notes: Green: node --test test/database-schema.test.js passed 2/2; node --test test/cli.test.js passed 87/87; node --test test/inbound-reconciliation-contract.test.js passed 19/19. Gate: npm run check passed; npm test passed with 675 tests. After a test-only cleanup, node --test test/cli.test.js passed 87/87 again.
